where_left_off: On Services → Kea DHCP → Kea DHCPv4 → Settings, LAN is selected and the main service Enabled checkbox is checked. The next step is to click Apply, confirm whether OPNsense accepts the configuration and starts the service, inspect any validation errors, then verify the subnet entry persists and confirm DHCP operation before proceeding to client testing. Do not claim a successful lease until a client actually obtains one.
